models.inverse_notes: I with positive R determines E = I x R; I with positive E determines R = E / I. R = 0 is excluded (intensity undefined); I = 0 with positive R implies zero emissions. Substitution checks: 0.02 x 250000 = 5000 recovers case mid-revenue; 5000 / 0.02 = 250000 recovers R. Algebraic only; revenue fluctuations can move the ratio without any physical change.
limitations: Revenue-basis intensity is sensitive to prices, currency and inflation; it must not be read as physical efficiency without a physical-denominator companion.
Cross-company comparison requires the same currency basis, Scope coverage and revenue definition.

references.method: Independent division in the TEAM/NetNada revenue-basis style (mass per currency); illustrative inputs, computed directly.
references.provenance: Independent arithmetic reasoning from stated illustrative inputs; not a published company figure.

models.inverse_notes: Md with Mc determines Mr = Md - Mc (needs Md >= Mc); Md with Mr determines Mc likewise. Substitution checks: 94 - 25 = 69 recovers case national-2018; 94 - 69 = 25 recovers Mc. Algebraic only; stream eligibility follows the stated method, not the arithmetic.
limitations: The subtotal inherits stream-eligibility disputes (contamination, rejected loads, double-counted transfer-station records) and does not certify final recovery.
Other food-management tonnage (17.7 Mt in 2018) is deliberately outside this subtotal under EPA's headline definition.

assumptions: Source assumption: all four ledger entries share the same reporting period, MSW scope and weight basis, with combustion meaning energy recovery only and landfilling as the residual (EPA 2018: 292.4 = 94 + 17.7 + 34.6 + 146.1).

Application profile: generation-balance residual; each subtracted aggregate (diverted, other-managed, combusted) must be measured under the same boundary with no double counting across transfer records.

gaps: Requires new quantity meanings for total, diverted, other-managed, combusted and disposed mass roles; new unit t (tonne). Scalar difference fits the engine once meanings/units exist.

models.inverse_notes: Any three knowns with the guard determine the fourth: Mt = Ml + Md + Mo + Mcb; Md = Mt - Ml - Mo - Mcb; and likewise for Mo, Mcb. Needs the unknown's equation to keep all guards (nonnegativity and Mt >= Md + Mo + Mcb). Substitution checks: 146.1 + 94 + 17.7 + 34.6 = 292.4 recovers case epa-2018-balance; 292.4 - 146.1 - 17.7 - 34.6 = 94 recovers Md. Algebraic only; residue quality and stream eligibility are not established by the subtraction.
limitations: A balance residual concentrates every ledger error; it must not be reported without the four stated inputs and their estimation methods.
Methodology changes (EPA's 2018 food-pathway expansion) break year-over-year comparability of the residual unless restated.

references.method: EPA 2018 ledger: 292.4 generated minus about 94 recycled-and-composted, 17.7 other food management and 34.6 combusted with energy recovery leaves about 146.1 landfilled (50%); expected independently subtracted.
references.provenance: Values from published EPA figures; the 146.1 residual is independently computed (headline figures rounded).

references.method: Boundary identity: with no diversion, other management or combustion, the residual equals total generation.

rejection_cases.reason: Subtracted aggregates (60) exceed generation (50), violating the Mt >= Md + Mo + Mcb balance guard.
